claims.claim: General Dynamics reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.1B (+8.1% YoY), EPS of $4.24 (+13.4%), $1.9B operating cash flow, and $136.5B backlog; company-wide book-to-bill was 1.4x.

Electric Boat received $29.5B for five additional Columbia-class submarines and $42.1B for nine additional Virginia-class submarines plus infrastructure support, strengthening long-duration demand visibility while increasing execution burden.

risks.risk: Large defense backlog creates multi-year execution, workforce, supplier and schedule exposure; award size is not equivalent to near-term revenue or margin realization.

unknowns.unknown: Scout evidence does not establish program-level margin, schedule performance, or numeric Earth Score inputs.

claims.claim: Q2 growth, cash conversion and 1.4x book-to-bill support an execution-positive operating signal, while the submarine awards make delivery capacity and schedule discipline central falsifiers for the backlog thesis.

risks.risk: Demand certainty can outpace physical throughput; future evidence should test delivery cadence and cost control rather than infer execution from backlog alone.

unknowns.unknown: No independent schedule-performance source was acquired in this Scout pass.
